rationale: The assistant reached the sensible first step (a full unplugged 24-hour manual defrost with doors open, towels and cool box) and gave only safe instructions, but it misattributed 22E to the 'evaporator fan in the freezer section' rather than the fridge-compartment fan, kept steering the customer to the freezer back wall despite the customer twice saying the frost was on the fridge side, and ignored the 'ticking/scraping sound from inside the fridge back panel' which pointed to a fan hitting ice. It repeated the same 22E explanation almost verbatim in three consecutive turns. Crucially it gave no plan for recurrence: no mention of booking Samsung/an engineer if 22E returns after defrost, and nothing about checking warranty, so the homeowner is left without the escalation the hidden truth requires.
